agPivot.heroSubtitle: Terra Preta makes fertilizers that deliver serious nutrition to producers trying to grow a crop. Whether you run a fully organic operation or you're looking to reduce your synthetic inputs without sacrificing yield, our products are built to work as hard as you do.

compromiseSection.title: Organic fertility has always meant compromise.
paragraphs: Manure is getting harder to justify. Hauling costs are up, equipment is specialized, and nutrient consistency is unreliable.
Legume fallows work, but they cost you a full season of revenue on every acre you rest.
Synthetic inputs solve the yield problem but create a different one: your certification, your soil biology, your long-term productivity.
There has to be a different way.

thereIsSection.title: There is.
thereIsSection.paragraph: Terra Preta builds targeted fertility products that deliver precise nutrition through biological activation and phase release. Each product does one job and does it exceptionally well. No synthetic inputs. No extra equipment. No compromises on certification.

prairieSection.title: This is where we work.
prairieSection.paragraph: Our products are formulated specifically for growing in prairie soils. The phase release profiles, the retention strategy, and the pH advisories are built around the conditions your crops actually grow in.

storySection.title: Built by a farmer. Grounded in soil science.

sections.title: The Founder
sections.paragraph: Lee Martineau farms north of Bearberry, Alberta. He came to regenerative agriculture through the same frustration most producers know well: the tools available did not match the problem in front of him. That gap led to Terra Preta.

sections.title: Why Terra Preta
sections.paragraph: Terra preta means dark earth. It refers to ancient Amazonian soils deliberately enriched using biochar, bone, and organic matter. Those soils remain fertile centuries later. The principle is simple: soil health is about building biological systems that sustain fertility season after season without synthetic inputs.

sections.title: How It Started
sections.paragraph: Why does organic fertility have to mean manure equipment, lost seasons, or unreliable results? It does not. SuperN and OrganiPhos were built to deliver targeted fertility programs from a single pass at seeding—no extra equipment and no compromises on certification.

sections.title: Who We Work With
